scope: Reuse existing local recipes and tests as design/source input for the canonical Loop-owned process adapter. No sibling source edits, new live model calls or replacement benchmark harness were made.

recipes.invariant: The exact Pi invocation distinguishes unspecified tools, an empty tool set, and an explicit allowlist; the prompt is a file reference.
recipes.transplant: Use pi -p --mode json --no-session, @prompt-file, --no-tools for an empty set, or --tools with explicit names. Add all discovery-suppression flags from the official upstream source for an isolated semantic step.

recipes.invariant: Pi output parsing follows an actually captured assistant message envelope and preserves transport errors.
recipes.transplant: Read message_end.message when role=assistant, extract text content parts, read usage.input/output and surface errorMessage. The current dirty source improves on the older committed parser.

do_not_copy: Pi usage defaults to zero when missing; canonical accounting must preserve null/unknown and known subtotals.
Deduplicating solely by timestamp can collapse distinct same-timestamp messages; use exact event identity when available.
splitlines treats Unicode separators as framing; Pi RPC documentation requires LF-only JSONL splitting.
The local_endpoint=unsupported assertion only tested OPENAI_BASE_URL. Pi supports custom endpoints through its isolated models.json provider registry.
REGISTRY contains OpenCode, Pi and Codex, not Aider despite the header's installed-binary list.
pure currently disables context files and extensions but does not explicitly disable skill/template/theme discovery.
Arbitrary extra_args are not an authority boundary. A canonical adapter must validate or own its exact argv.

recipes.invariant: Preserve mixed CREATE/EDIT order and validate the entire requested edit set before writing any member.
recipes.transplant: Add corresponding adversarial controls to the existing canonical workspace/artifact service; do not create a second write-authority service.

recipes.invariant: Freeze evaluator identity before candidate work and refuse acceptance if the evaluator changed even when its exit code is zero.
recipes.transplant: Bind canonical evaluator/source bytes before dispatch, then retain the existing changed-gate negative control at tests/test_harness.py:107.

recipes.invariant: A timeout owns and terminates the process group, then waits for output/drain.
recipes.transplant: Reuse the process-group cleanup sequence at the declared external-process adapter and add cancellation as a separate path.

recipes.invariant: Offline controls include prose-only replies, plausible wrong edits, tampered evaluators, repair after feedback and an unsolvable floor.
recipes.transplant: Extend existing canonical conformance fixtures with these response classes; keep synthetic controls separate from real-provider results.

do_not_copy: Gate.sandbox is a label; Gate.run executes bash on the host and does not instantiate a sandbox.
The effect screen is substring matching on a command, not typed authority.
The child environment retains HOME/PYTHONPATH and drops PYTHONNOUSERSITE. This can reload the known global usercustomize.py monkeypatch.
Gate-path heuristics do not completely identify an arbitrary evaluator's dependencies.
Edit staging avoids partial validation writes but is not a crash-atomic filesystem transaction.
repo.prepare removes an existing destination; do not transplant its overwrite policy into a shared workspace.
FakeSession and Cost use synthetic or zero-default token accounting; do not use them as real-provider accounting authorities.

recipes.transplant: Responses object plus response.created/response.completed event framing as an initial offline parser control.
Anthropic Messages non-streaming response shape as an offline parser control.
ChatCompletions role/content/finish chunks followed by data: [DONE], plus non-streaming completion shape.
Compare materialized messages and tool schema exposure in normalized tokenizer units, with the tokenizer named explicitly.

do_not_copy: Hardcoded usage 0 input / 1 output is fixture data, never provider-reported usage.
HTTPServer is single threaded; use the already-owned canonical broker concurrency model.
Anthropic streaming and detailed Responses delta sequences are not implemented by this probe.
No request authentication, exact route authority, body-size bound or timeout policy is established by this file.
Normalizing JSON and tokenizing with cl100k_base is not a qualified exact-wire token bound for every provider/model.

limits: The report's table is useful reported evidence but its cited current log does not retain those eight arms.
Measurements include the task text and normalized JSON wrappers; they are not pure prefix-only provider-token measurements.
A 3 percent difference from a prior provider run is not exact-request bound qualification.

retry.scope: Existing parser/path/edit/env tests only. Gate subprocess and full-harness tests were not rerun; no canonical integration claim.

first_batch_semantic_step_findings.recommended_next_step: Probe installed CLI with no-tools and all discovery suppressions, isolated models.json and JSONL parsing; use captured Pi fixture for parser negatives.
Probe --disabled-tools '*' and JSON/streaming output against engine broker; isolate VIBE_HOME.
Probe ask mode and no-Git/no-update/no-analytics controls using --message-file. Do not assume auxiliary model-call count equals one.
Probe --no-profile --instructions - --output-format stream-json with GOOSE_MODE=chat and native brokered provider; reject delegated CLI providers.
Pin exact registry and disable every discovered builtin/system/MCP tool; tools.core=[] and tools.eager are insufficient.
Probe JSON stdin and --compaction off. CLI-wide no-tools remains unverified; connector no-tools and SDK enableTools must not be mistaken for main CLI flags.
Implement and qualify an explicit tool-free adapter or SDK variant. Current CLI overwrites stored tools with get_default_cli_tools on new sessions, so tools=[] in persisted settings is insufficient.
Use its existing action-parser/trajectory controls as reference; pure semantic JSON needs an explicit adapter because stock CLI expects executable actions and a submission action.
